description: This file defines the class I18NTranslationSearchFilterParams, used for filtering search results related to internationalization translation strings within the OrangeHRM application. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties and methods for handling language ID, source text, translated text, group ID, and a flag for only translated entries.

classes.name: I18NTranslationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for specifying filters in translation string search queries, including language, text filters, group filters, and translation status flags.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the language ID used for filtering translations.

methods.name: setLanguageId
methods.description: Sets the language ID for filtering translations.

methods.name: getSourceText
methods.description: Returns the source text filter criterion.

methods.name: setSourceText
methods.description: Sets the source text filter criterion.

methods.name: getTranslatedText
methods.description: Returns the translated text filter criterion.

methods.name: setTranslatedText
methods.description: Sets the translated text filter criterion.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setGroupId
methods.description: Sets the group ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getOnlyTranslated
methods.description: Returns the flag indicating whether to filter only translated entries.

methods.name: setOnlyTranslated
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating whether to filter only translated entries.
